invariants: All 90 core registry actions appear exactly once; source actor, entry, route and returnTarget are copied byte-for-byte. The independent L3 Book Lab namespace is gated separately and has zero action-ID overlap.
Every API mutation requires Idempotency-Key, declares a replayClass, and references only Version/CAS Dictionary fields.

A technicalOperationCoverage entry that mirrors a top-level action is a reference, not a second contract: endpoint, method, authorization, requestSchema, successDTO, stableErrors, idempotency, replayClass and ifMatchOrVersion must be exactly equal.

CredentialCryptoProfile uses 256-bit generated bearer secrets, keyed HMAC storage with keyId, bound peppered OTP MACs, constant-time comparison, dual-read/single-write rotation and no-store responses.
Credential and Set-Cookie responses are never cached in idempotency records; secret-once replay uses a short same-principal AEAD envelope and cannot recover an expired secret.
Viewer authorization chooses exactly one branch: account owner/member task=view without shared, or external viewer with active+shared+live campaign/grant/viewer-principal/session.
All manager placement writes share the atomic item-lock template; a receipt writer never manager-locks its own item.
Space create atomically initializes one Scene and ownerAccountId without an owner Membership; panorama switch/rollback CAS and increment both Space and Scene.
Account authentication rechecks accounts.sessionEpoch; logout-all revokes every family/session for the account.
Identifier identity uniqueness is enforced by rotation-invariant identifier_equivalences and active equivalence-to-Account binding; rotatable keyed-MAC aliases never define identity uniqueness.

Every new identifier equivalence stores a separately keyed KMS-AEAD normalized-identity envelope; IDENTITY.REKEY_EQUIVALENCES is the only full-table collision-key switch and is all-or-nothing under an exclusive lease.
Member invitation unavailable states are externally indistinguishable as member_invite_unavailable.
Owner transfer is target-account bound and never issues a bearer credential or copyable link.
Content transitionReasonCode and decisionReasonCode are disjoint; every content action uses the product registry's exact allowlist and other requires note.

Every content case stores exactly one CaseActorRelationKind branch with explicit FK/version columns; revoked resource sessions never regain object access, while a live independent case_access session or same active Account may retain only the minimal case envelope and appeal path.
Panorama upload is an explicit candidate/ticket/upload/commit/validate/status/retry workflow; only ready revisions switch.

Viewer scene context contains only same-origin session-auth media locators and immutable photo/panorama identity. Both subordinate media GETs are repeatable zero-write reads with current authorization, single-Range, no-store, same-origin and hash/ETag checks; no capability, secret, one-time or signed-query field exists.
V1 panorama observed byte ceiling is exactly 33,554,432; 33,554,433 is rejected and no 50 MiB ceiling remains.

External INVITATION.COPY_LINK copies the non-sensitive campaign URL from the management read model; member copy remains one-time; INVITATION.SHOW_QR renders that campaign URL locally with no network or analytics; BATCH.OPEN_ITEM is the resource-scoped batch item GET.

Every receipt exchange, refresh, recovery and read model reloads the composite Space row and requires spaceLifecycle=active; archived returns batch_access_unavailable and never issues a receipt session or content DTO.
UPLOAD.REMOVE_ITEM changes only an open batch item from failed to removed; a new request for selected/uploading/validating/committed/removed/deleted or any non-open batch returns item_state_conflict.

MANAGE.OPEN_NEXT is a server-current management read-model selector: it rechecks scope/actionability, returns only target/empty on success, maps exhausted bounded concurrent reselection to the product-frozen stable error concurrent_change, and never exposes a raced or unauthorized target.

BATCH.OPEN_ACCOUNT_UPLOADS is an account-bound summary GET only; selecting a binding is required before BATCH.RECOVER_FROM_ACCOUNT and the list never issues a receipt session or returns batch/photo content.

Default URL bearer is prohibited. The complete bootstrap exception set is per-visitor/member invitation #invite= and receipt #receipt=; each is earliest same-origin, memory-only, immediately replaceState-cleared, single-consume and family-separated before its POST exchange. /open/{publicCampaignId} is a non-credential locator that cannot call business APIs.

Campaign challenge binds campaignId+clientNonce under a fixed __Host- Strict cookie and same-origin Fetch-Metadata checks; admission locks challenge+campaign, rejects cross-campaign reuse uniformly, and uses secret_once idempotency.

Campaign grants split bootstrapExpiresAt from accessExpiresAt; audit is append-only and contains no secret, raw URL/IP/full UA or cross-campaign stable visitor key; use ordinal means exchange/browser principal, not a unique natural person.

CAMPAIGN.SWEEP_EXPIRATIONS is one internal, non-HTTP, at-least-once operation: terminal expiry fields, loaded versions and partial-unique audit events make challenge/grant/campaign cleanup idempotent; an abandoned grant releases pending exactly once while an exchanged session remains live until access expiry.
V1 report and appeal schemas reject attachment, asset, uploadSession and multipart fields with unsupported_field; no case-media upload workflow exists.
Generic support accepts only category+description; contact and all unknown fields return unsupported_field before any case or idempotency business row is created.

Account deletion atomically creates an exact deletion-status session and returns it only in __Host-unseen_deletion_status while clearing account authority; status sessions cannot access any other endpoint and are never stored in idempotency responses or reused from case_access_sessions.
